text.p: Transworld Home HealthCare (UK) Ltd said on Wednesday it had offered 167p per share in an agreed takeover of Omnicare Plc.
Transworld, a subsidiary of U.S. group Transworld Healthcare Inc, said the offer valued Omnicare at 19.79 million stg.

It said it had an irrevocable acceptance from Omnicare's major shareholder Stanton Industries Ltd for almost 36 percent of Omnicare and now owned or had acceptances for 50.83 percent of Omnicare's issued share capital.
Omnicare said in April it had received a approach which might lead to a takeover bid.
Transworld said the acquisition offered growth potential because home healthcare in Britain was still at an early stage.
It said Omnicare would serve as a platform for more growth
